articles.title: India's youth driving advances in AI, space & deep tech: PM Narendra Modi
articles.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi highlighted India's youth as crucial drivers for the nation's rapid economic and technological growth. He noted India's emergence as the world's second-largest mobile phone manufacturer and the third-largest startup ecosystem. This success underscores the vibrant entrepreneurial spirit and innovative capabilities of young Indians, positioning the country as a major global player in manufacturing and digital innovation.

articles.title: 3 killed, property damaged in Malabar
articles.summary: Outer Delhi reported a tragic snakebite claiming a woman and her teen daughter. Separately, political tensions escalated in Karnataka as Nainar accused the CM of insulting Vijay amidst ongoing Cauvery river protests, highlighting inter-state water sharing challenges. Furthermore, nine arrests were made following a murder linked to campus rivalry, indicating concerns over law and order.

articles.title: How Rufus Sewell Found a TV Role Worth Staying For
articles.summary: Renowned actor Rufus Sewell has deliberately avoided long-running TV series throughout his decades-long career. He attributes this professional choice to a personal apprehension regarding career security, stating that the very idea of it has historically filled him with fear. This approach has allowed him to pursue diverse roles rather than being tied to a single, continuous show.

articles.title: Betting the Rams in 2026: See how Los Angeles' win total, Super Bowl odds are trending and our best bets
articles.summary: The Rams, despite leading league scoring in 2025, failed to win their division due to a crucial 38-37 overtime loss to the Seahawks. To remedy this, the team is now strategically shifting focus towards creating the best defense. This move highlights a major operational re-evaluation aimed at improving overall performance and securing future divisional success.
